name: Blind Pass Resort
description: A 25-room boutique hotel a short walk from the Gulf waters of St. Pete Beach. Guests have a temperature-controlled pool with courtyard fountains, free Wi-Fi and parking, and a free shuttle around the island and its beaches.
alt: Pool and loungers at Blind Pass Resort at dusk, with palm trees and pink buildings

name: Bluebird Day Inn & Suites
description: Set across the street from Lake Tahoe, within walking distance of the local beaches and five minutes from the base of Heavenly Ski Mountain. Guests get free wireless internet, fresh coffee and views of the trees and mountains.
alt: Lawn with loungers in front of Bluebird Day Inn & Suites, with pine-covered mountains behind

name: Coastal Suites
description: A hotel off Highway 17, near Historic Downtown Wilmington and the University of North Carolina Wilmington. Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach and Fort Fisher are all nearby.
alt: Two-storey exterior of Coastal Suites with trees and a parking lot

name: Geneva Riverside Hotel & Tiki Bar
description: A riverside lodge in Lake Lure with an onsite Tiki Bar & Grill. The lodge is surrounded by flowing creeks and mature trees, a short distance from the lake, and guests can fish for bass and trout on the property.
alt: Pool deck at Geneva Riverside Hotel with tables, umbrellas and wooded hills behind

name: Hickory Falls Inn
description: A pet-friendly boutique hotel in the Western North Carolina mountains, with twelve redesigned guest rooms, serene grounds and views of Hickory Nut Falls. Chimney Rock State Park and the shops and eateries of Chimney Rock Village are close by.
alt: Vine-covered exterior of Hickory Falls Inn

name: Island House Resort Hotel
description: A relaxed boutique beach hotel just across Gulf Boulevard from the white-sand beach. Guests have spacious accommodations, a large outdoor pool, a furnished sundeck, and easy access to St. Pete Beach and Clearwater.
alt: Large outdoor pool and courtyard at Island House Resort Hotel

name: Malibu Resort Motel
description: A family-oriented, retro boutique motel with a heated pool, a grassy lawn and a large sun deck. The beach and Gulf waters are right across the street, with local shops within walking distance.
alt: Aerial view of Malibu Resort Motel near the beach

name: Patriots’ Boutique Motel
description: A coastal boutique motel close to the San Clemente Pier and the shops and restaurants of Avenida Del Mar. Rooms include Double Queen, King and a suite with a full kitchen, private patio, BBQ and fire pit, and Trestles and T-Street beaches are a short drive away.
alt: Courtyard with red umbrellas, palm trees and seating at Patriots’ Boutique Motel

name: Sea Shells Beach Club
description: An oceanfront resort on Daytona Beach, with stays by the night, by the week or longer. The pier, Ocean Walk and beach activities are within walking distance, and rooms range from studios and efficiencies to one- and two-bedroom suites.
alt: Sea Shells Beach Club building at sunset

name: The Pineola
description: A mountain getaway with RV sites, cabins and lodge rooms, five minutes from the Blue Ridge Parkway and ten from Grandfather Mountain. The Pineola Grill serves local craft beers, wines, ciders and cocktails, with live music on weekends.
alt: Aerial view of The Pineola with mountains behind
